scoringNotes: No reward for short code, verbose handoffs, helper removal, or additional test count. All production behavior scores are grounded in complete patch/source review plus the frozen passing hidden checks.

Saved tests use the required 8 regression / 8 preservation-and-alternate-path / 4 isolation allocation. Partial coverage is scored separately from the mandatory both-transformer directory regression gate.

Within the 8 coverage points, the same checks were applied to every suite: file/symlink/non-file classifications and a non-ENOENT probe failure (2); multiline and literal CSV trimming plus literal newline and empty-file preservation (2); JSON output categories including falsy values (1); actual file-first precedence (1); parse-error contexts/identity/original messages (1); read-error identity/path/original message (1).
Point deductions identify omitted or weak saved assertions, not hypothetical candidate source regressions. No new production regression was proposed or used to alter a gate.

Scope omissions are distinguished from materially false verification claims. The static-checker claims in 001, 003, 016, 023, 025, 031, 032, 034 and 036 were checked against final available evidence; intentional warnings and actual final clean scoped scans were treated as such.
Equal totals are ties under the available evidence, not claims that every test file is identical. Artifacts 002 and 036 have identical production source but different saved tests.
